question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's removal of presidential term limits in 2018, combined with sustained anti-corruption campaigns and recent military leadership purges through 2026, has entrenched his control over the Communist Party and People's Liberation Army. With no designated successor elevated to the Politburo Standing Committee and expectations centered on a fourth term at the 2027 Party Congress, traders assess near-zero near-term risk of ouster. This consensus aligns with the absence of visible factional opposition or institutional mechanisms capable of forcing an exit before 2027. Realistic shifts could still arise from acute health developments, an unprecedented internal challenge during elite personnel decisions, or major external shocks that expose vulnerabilities in leadership continuity.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders price a fragmented Democratic field for the 2028 nomination with no candidate above 21 percent, as Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez leads at 20.1 percent ahead of Gavin Newsom and Jon Ossoff.
